summary: Hardening review passed for the exact committed candidate. One rough request is assessed once and one controller invocation drives two serial managed tasks through isolated worktrees, actual build/critic/repair worker processes, local Git publication, cleanup and a grounded goal audit. The first critic is forced to block and its exact feedback reaches repair before a second critic can pass. The unresolved-decision case still publishes independent work but cannot report goal completion; omitted intake outcomes fail before durable intake or worker execution; dirty control state preserves user bytes and withholds publication. The executable coverage manifest binds each additional recovery, cumulative-budget, changed-base, lost-acknowledgement, live-readback, cleanup and false-green claim to a named behavioral test, and compatibility invokes the full autonomy gate. Review corrected the independent beta acceptance from a hardcoded ordinal version to an actual next-release receipt. Documentation explicitly limits the proof to deterministic adapters, disposable local Git and no hosted, production, live-model, overnight or GitHub Actions claim. All five autonomous-campaign quality attributes are covered without duplicating runtime state or effect ownership. Exact-candidate verification, make, validate, diff, 155 compatibility tests and 26 injected-failure tests pass; no blocking finding remains.
